'''Lucky''' was a [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone trooper]] who served under [[Clone Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Rex/Legends|Rex]] and [[Jedi General/Legends|Jedi General]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]].

==Biography==
Lucky was part of a boarding team to assist [[Aayla Secura/Legends|Aayla Secura's]] [[Venator-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Venator''-class Star Destroyer]] during the [[Sky Battle of Quell]]. He was killed by a [[Mastiff phalone/Legends|mastiff phalone]] on [[Maridun/Legends|Maridun]] while trying to find the [[Planet/Legends|planet's]] natives, whom they needed to heal [[Jedi General/Legends|General]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]].
